Homework has long been tied to school.
The idea of homework goes back a long way.

As educators recognized the limitations of passive, one-size-fits-all tasks in encouraging genuine understanding and student engagement, traditional worksheets and reading logs gave way to project-based assignments or online lessons, clouding the line between homework and classwork.
So, what now?
Keep, change, or get rid of it?
The thing is, homework isn't automatically good or bad.
It took on a more formal role during the Industrial Revolution.
